scope: Standalone FusionFileStudy decoder and saved captures; current TryUniCAD repository used as the comment-style reference. This is not an audit of all TryUniCAD adapters or a native-writer certification.

repairs.problem: Finite native values could overflow their millimetre or degree display conversion and publish infinity.
repairs.result: Overflow is explicitly rejected through existing parameter or unsupported-curve diagnostics; 33 native-byte cases verify accepted and rejected numeric boundaries.

repairs.area: Rational curves derivatives and tensor surfaces
repairs.problem: Equivalent common weight scales could underflow or overflow homogeneous intermediates, crash derivative evaluation or return incorrect finite geometry. Finite extreme knots could silently produce a wrong interpolation coefficient.
repairs.result: Ordinary floating arithmetic stays the fast path. Unsafe intermediates trigger projective Decimal evaluation from exact binary64 inputs, with extended exponent range and degree-dependent precision. Mixed extreme-weight endpoints and previously accepted higher degrees remain supported.

repairs.problem: Quoted Text-literal dependencies differed between the parameter-only and full readers.
repairs.result: Both entrypoints now apply the existing Text-literal dependency merge and agree on value source and empty reference lists.

repairs.problem: Seven older validators asserted historical unsupported layouts, unextended summaries or mutable inventory counts. One sampled a native endpoint just outside the separate UV domain.
repairs.result: Coverage expectations follow independently corroborated newer decoders; Mirror-owned routes and Text literals receive explicit checks; Stitch targets use a committed inventory; UV comparisons stay inside the actual common domain and strict out-of-domain rejection remains tested.

style_reference.limitation: Counts syntax and placement; explanatory purpose still needs human review

summary.boundary_coordinate_scope: Measured after complete incident-FACE-name joins; differences do not invalidate naming correspondence or establish identical geometry

limitations: Successful saved-file execution and byte preservation do not prove semantic correctness for unobserved native records, unsupported modes or other Fusion versions.

The style audit intentionally reports failure for the remaining legacy files. Only changed Python files were brought into the current rationale-comment convention; the complete style migration has not been performed.

Historical integration comparisons depending on old temporary baseline caches were inventoried separately rather than reported as freshly passing tests. The current full corpus was compared against outputs acquired from the unchanged pre-repair reader.
No live Fusion sessions or full editable-file translation roundtrips were performed.
